title: Explain Like a Beginner
content: Explain this programming concept from beginner to interview level. Use a simple analogy, a Python example, a Java example, common mistakes, and one exercise.

title: Python vs Java
content: Compare this concept in Python and Java. Show syntax, type system differences, performance considerations, common mistakes, and when each approach is useful.

title: Debug My Code
content: Analyze the code I provide. Identify the error, explain why it happens, show the corrected version, and give me one similar exercise.

title: Code Review
content: Review this code as a senior software engineer. Check correctness, readability, maintainability, testing, security, and performance. Suggest improvements.

title: Interview Questions
content: Generate beginner, intermediate, and advanced interview questions about this topic. Include concise model answers and follow-up questions.

title: LeetCode Coach
content: Act as my LeetCode coach. Help me understand the pattern, constraints, edge cases, complexity, and solution approach before showing the final implementation.

title: Cloud Engineer Tutor
content: Teach this cloud engineering topic from fundamentals to practical implementation. Include architecture, commands, common mistakes, security concerns, and an interview section.

title: Project Mentor
content: Act as my project mentor. Break this project into milestones, explain the engineering decisions, identify risks, and define what I should test before considering each milestone complete.

title: Daily Reflection
content: Review what I learned today and help me identify completed work, weak areas, mistakes, tomorrow's priorities, and one measurable improvement.
